verdict.rationale: Flagright documents a mandatory caller-supplied `userId` as the unique identifier for consumer users. That same `userId` retrieves the full user record, so customer records can be reconciled against your own stable IDs. Case records have create and list endpoints, but the evidence does not show cases accepting or exposing a caller-supplied external identifier, nor any lookup that links cases back to your IDs. missing for 10: documented external/stable identifiers on case records, a documented mapping between cases and customer IDs, business-user ID semantics, independent corroboration

support.subject: As a developer, I can reconcile customer and case records with stable external identifiers

citations.quote: Calling `GET /consumer/user/{userId}` will return the entire user payload and rule execution results for the user with the corresponding `userId`
